items.label: MA-AG administrative: Azumi LLC
items.detail: Fair Labor Division citation of the Boston restaurant Zuma for letting managerial Captains share in the tip pool (July 2022 to July 2024); date is the announcement date. Citation totals approximately $1,813,850 in penalties and restitution for unpaid wages; manager Garrett Ronan was also cited and is left out; release says nothing on admission.

items.label: USAO-MA civil: Azumi, LLC; Zuma NYC, LLC; Zuma Las Vegas, LLC; Zuma Japanese Restaurant Miami, LLC; Inko Nito Garey St., LLC; and Beach Chu Hallandale, LLC
items.detail: False Claims Act qui tam settlement over second-draw PPP loans that exceeded the corporate group limit; date is the announcement date. The six restaurant entities (collectively the Azumi Entities, owned by Azumi Limited) pay $3,602,423 together as one combined sum, and the release says they admitted exceeding the limit, hence admitted yes. | One total paid by entities of this one company: counted once, in full, $3,602,423 (data/manual/shared-allocations.csv).
